title: predict
summary: Predict responses from a fitted model.

gpu_support.notes: GPU predictor inputs are gathered to host for model prediction.

description: `predict(mdl,Xnew)` evaluates supported fitted model objects, including `LinearModel` from `fitlm` and `ClassificationTree` from `fitctree`, on new matrix or table predictor data.
behaviors: `Xnew` can be a numeric matrix with the same predictor column count used during fitting.
For table input, predictor variables are selected by the model's `PredictorNames` property.
For `LinearModel`, `[ypred,yci] = predict(...)` returns pointwise confidence intervals for curve predictions by default.
For `ClassificationTree`, `[label,score,node,cnum] = predict(...)` returns predicted class labels, posterior probabilities, one-based leaf node ids, and one-based class-number predictions.

Linear-model name-value options `Alpha`, `Prediction`, and `Simultaneous` are accepted. `Prediction` can be `curve` or `observation`; `Simultaneous` must be false because simultaneous intervals are not supported yet.
Classification-tree prediction currently accepts matrix or table predictor data and raises explicit errors for unsupported pruning/subtree options.

examples.output: yci is a two-column matrix with lower and upper bounds.

examples.description: Predict classes from a classification tree
examples.output: label is [0; 1], and score has one posterior-probability column per class.

faqs.question: Which model classes are supported?
faqs.answer: Currently `predict` supports `LinearModel` objects returned by `fitlm` and `ClassificationTree` objects returned by `fitctree`.
